title: Connect rope operators to production fixed ticks
requires: Production runtime/toolchain plus applicable physical GPU; cross-platform build evidence
scope: Bind F8-10/F8-15 rope prediction, segment/bend/attachment constraints and commit to the native fixed-tick schedule; remove rope-driven smaller-step behavior from this path. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md.
acceptance: An installed public rope fixture advances exactly once at 1/60 with eight fixed iterations and the shared spatial epoch; no maximum_substep_timestep escape to another scheduler.
Independent stretch, bend, attachment and tunneling limits pass on an applicable physical GPU, including cold starts, impulses and high mass ratios within the contract.
Pin/endpoint edits, reset, replacement and failed-tick recovery preserve coherent state generations and consume pending input once.
Preserve all already supported rope semantics; missing P-series capsule/pair features are not silently advertised.
